plan.notes: Source: University of Alabama 2026-2027 Academic Catalog, Psychology requirements at https://catalog.ua.edu/undergraduate/arts-sciences/psychology/bs/. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester-by-semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block. General-education, college, minor, and free-elective requirements that bring the degree to 120 hours are not itemized here; see the catalog. Choice slots recorded at minimum credit per convention.

courses.title: Introduction to Psychology
courses.choice_note: PY 101 or PY 105 Honors Introduction to Psychology

courses.title: Elementary Statistical Methods
courses.choice_note: PY 211 or PY 212 Statistics for Psychology

courses.title: Psychology Elective (300/400 level)
courses.choice_note: 3 hours of PY elective at 300 or 400 level

courses.title: Psychology Content Area Course 1
courses.choice_note: One course from a first content area (Developmental: PY 352/365/461; Learning/Cognitive: PY 361/381/470; Social/Personality: PY 358/368/372; Biological: PY 313/353/413/382)

courses.title: Psychology Content Area Course 2
courses.choice_note: One course from a second content area (same area list)

courses.title: Psychology Content Area Course 3
courses.choice_note: One course from a third content area (same area list)

courses.title: Calculus I
courses.choice_note: MATH 125 or MATH 145 Honors Calculus I (ancillary)

courses.title: Ancillary Science
courses.choice_note: Select 8 hours from: BSC 108, BSC 109, BSC 114 & 115, BSC 116 & 117, BSC 118, BSC 120, CH 101, CH 102, CH 104, CH 105, CH 117, CH 118, PH 101, PH 102, PH 105, PH 106, PH 115 (ancillary)
